question.text: How many nominees can a demat account holder appoint?

explanation.text: The Logic: The client(s) may nominate up to ten persons by filing the nomination form, specifying the percentage allocation among the nominees. The Trap: Lower nominee limits sound plausible but the current rule for demat accounts is up to 10 nominees. Note: The Series VI workbook (pp.119-120) is the controlling source for the current rule of up to 10 nominees and for the percentage allocation requirement at the ISIN level.
